items:
Blue Honey is a luxury 4+BR WaterColor home on a quiet street. It has a private heated pool, screened sleeping porch and is just steps from Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club. Ideal for families who want comfort, convenience, and easy access to the beach and village life. The house is very quiet and private with the nature preserve to the rear and a park in the front. The house has 3,910 square feet of heated/cooled living space after the 2025 renovations.

Top perks
- Private heated pool with water features and gas fire pit (pool heat $175)
- Six adult bikes included; 6-seat electric golf cart available ($600/week)
- Four community pools, Sonos sound system, 7 flat screens, fiber WiFi, two ice makers and two wine coolers/beverage centers
- Restoration Hardware mattresses, luxury linens, robes, pool & beach towels provided
- Sleeps 12; parking for 3 cars; pets not allowed
- Fully equipped professional kitchen with everything you need

The association requires anyone age 5 or older to have a wristband to access the amenities. Wristbands are available for up to 12 individuals. Each recipient needs to be staying at the house.

Layout highlights
- First floor: guest bedroom with queen, private bath, porch access
- New luxury dining room with seating for 12
- Fully equipped gourmet kitchen and bar area for easy
- Second floor: master suite with king, sitting room, screened porch access
- Additional 2nd floor bedrooms: two queens in one room; queen in another; upstairs screened sleeping porch with 2 daybeds
entertaining
-Third Floor: Large family room, laundry, bar, bath and bedroom

Location
- 2 blocks to Camp WaterColor; short walk or ride to Beach Club, Seaside, tennis/pickleball center
- Nature preserve behind home and a park across the street for peace and privacy

Practical info
- 50% deposit to reserve; balance due 60 days before arrival. VRBO collects taxes and guest fees.
- Weddings not allowed. Home is managed by hosts available by phone or text.

Book Blue Honey for a quiet, upscale WaterColor stay with pool, bikes, and easy access to all 30A favorites.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
